scope: Aggregate captured sampled-visible-fire episode reports from a declared held-out cohort, not field validation
split_guards: No recording ID, source-video hash, cluster ID, site ID or capture date may cross splits. Source-video hashes must be unique even within a split. Group metadata is self-reported, not verified independence.
path_base: Input CSV paths must be relative to its parent; frozen registry references are rebased relative to registry output directory
report_plan: Train/validation report paths must be blank; test report paths are required but may not exist when registry is frozen
aggregation: Pool captured event counts and negative sampled-bin exposure; do not average per-recording ratios
compatibility: All test reports must use the same event protocol, scientific/decoder source hashes, detector configuration and sample_fps; different sampling rates change consecutive-frame persistence
delay: Pool detected-only delays; nearest rank, misses remain explicit counts and never become zero delay
resampling_unit: Declared cluster_id; resample all G clusters with replacement G times, retaining every recording and event in each selected cluster
informative_cluster: Positive truth denominator for recall, positive alarm denominator for precision, positive nonfire exposure for false-onset rate, at least one matched delay for delay quantiles
undefined_draws: Omit zero-denominator draws separately per metric, report valid_bootstrap_draws; no interval when fewer than two informative clusters; fail if an interval-eligible metric has no defined draws
uncertainty: Pointwise nominal 95% percentile cluster-bootstrap intervals; not simultaneous, input/model/label uncertainty, or a guarantee of empirical coverage, especially for small cohorts
non_goals: No actual independently labelled footage is supplied or fabricated
No threshold tuning, model comparison, acceptance verdict or field accuracy claim
No rerunning captured detectors, single-recording evaluations or frozen simulations
No database, service, deployment, purchases, downloads or additional dependencies
